name: bandit.phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 generated-weather optical forest replay on the accepted transformed-forest child. The retained fog-search turn must serialize terrain-opportunity dispatch, approach, and exact watch before reporting the live weather, optical budget, acquisition, and outcome without fixture-side value assumptions.

steps.label: post_load_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the generated-weather optical forest/horde fixture reaches normal gameplay; this is startup footing only
steps.failure_rule: If gameplay does not load, no live visibility proof can be credited.

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_site
steps.abort_reason: saved state did not contain the idle five-member camp and accepted terrain-opportunity route before the visibility run
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members and the accepted target route are idle before production dispatch

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_horde
steps.abort_reason: saved overmap metadata did not contain three concrete hostile entities on transformed forest target (137,49,0)
steps.expected_immediate_state: three distinct concrete mon_zombie entities occupy transformed forest target (137,49,0) before runtime

steps.label: wait_first_6_hours_toward_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_due
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: six real game hours pass while production initializes the exact camp's routine activation clock
steps.failure_rule: If the first bounded wait does not complete, the deterministic dispatch window is not reached.

steps.label: wait_second_6_hours_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_dispatch
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the real hourly cadence crosses the accepted due boundary and dispatches an exact pair toward transformed forest target (137,49,0)
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded wait lacks the exact dispatch artifact, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_first_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_approach
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the first post-dispatch owner hour reaches the accepted approach OMT without collapsing approach and exact-watch arrival
steps.failure_rule: If the first post-dispatch hour does not reach scheduler hour 181 at minute 10860, the serialized approach transition is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_second_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_observer
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the second post-dispatch owner hour reaches exact watch (138,52,0) and records the generated weather and optical visibility result through transformed forest target (137,49,0)
steps.failure_rule: If the second post-dispatch hour lacks visibility at scheduler hour 182 and minute 10920, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_artifact
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug delta did not expose the exact-watch generated weather and optical result
steps.failure_rule: No generated-weather optical row credit if terrain-opportunity dispatch and the value-complete exact-watch visibility line are not both present.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_fog_requires_nonempty_dynamic_values
steps.abort_reason: the exact-watch visibility trace contained an empty weather, budget, acquisition, or outcome value
steps.failure_rule: An empty dynamic value makes the generated-weather observation inconclusive.

evidence_contract.claim: the retained fog-search turn drives the accepted terrain-opportunity pair through separate dispatch and approach hours to exact watch (138,52,0), where production reports nonempty generated weather, penalty, optical budget, acquisition, and outcome fields for transformed forest target (137,49,0) at distance three
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for structural visibility
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 generated-weather optical row credit unless startup, inherited target-only forest and binocular footing, exact three-entity target, elapsed terrain-opportunity dispatch, separate approach and watch hours, exact watch/target geometry, actual optic, and nonempty production-derived weather and result fields are separately green.
